mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and consumer price inflation signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL have risen for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, housing starts exceeding 800,000 units per month indicate strengthening demand for residential construction, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with HOUST above 800,000 units during the post-recession recovery phase, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past 3 months reflects a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95 (index 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and mining output that reduces corporate profits, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 95, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in quarterly GDP growth and monthly housing starts signals robust aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST have risen for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a zero-interest-rate policy regime, where the federal funds rate is below 0.1%, the central bank's commitment to ultra-low rates supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS below 0.1% during the zero-interest-rate policy regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
